name: Flexing for Nougat
summary: During autumn's Hallow's End, you gather festive sweets for an orphan in Stormwind. Innkeeper Allison at the Gilded Rose asks you to flex before she gives you Stormwind Nougat.

sections.title: A Hallow's End Tradition
sections.body: Hallow's End brings a lighter mood to Stormwind's streets. The holiday marks the turning of the seasons and wards off dark spirits. Common folk celebrate with disguises, revelry, and trick-or-treating. Alliance innkeepers join in, offering traditional sweets to those who perform a harmless trick.

sections.title: Entertaining the Innkeeper
sections.body: At the Gilded Rose in the Trade District, Innkeeper Allison asks for a show before handing out holiday candy, even when you're gathering sweets for Jesper, an orphaned boy. She comments playfully on your physique and asks you to flex your muscles. When you do, she gives you a piece of chewy Stormwind Nougat.

faq.q: Why does Innkeeper Allison make people flex?
faq.answer: Hallow's End trades tricks for treats, so Innkeeper Allison asks you to show off your muscles before giving you the sweet.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You meet Innkeeper Allison at the Gilded Rose, in the heart of Stormwind's Trade District, where she tends the tavern counter.

faq.q: Who is the Stormwind Nougat meant for?
faq.answer: The nougat is for Jesper, an orphan boy staying in Stormwind. He hopes to taste traditional festival treats from each major Alliance city during Hallow's End.
Stormwind Nougat is a regional sweet Stormwind's innkeepers hand out during Hallow's End. Festival-goers know it as one of the human kingdom's signature treats.

faq.q: Can Horde players obtain this treat from Allison?
faq.answer: No. Innkeeper Allison lives deep within Alliance-controlled Stormwind City and serves Alliance members. Horde adventurers perform their own festive tricks for innkeepers in their capital cities.

aliases: when is flexing for nougat available
faq.answer: No. Innkeeper Allison offers this request only during Hallow's End, the seasonal festival when trick-or-treating customs fill the cities.

angles.text: For the Alliance, this playful exchange reflects Stormwind's lighter community spirit during Hallow's End and other seasonal festivals, bringing citizens and wandering heroes together for a laugh.
As a human in Stormwind, you know indulging children and trading tricks for treats is a cherished seasonal custom. It offers brief relief from the darker perils facing the kingdom.
As a warrior, you know bloody battlefields well. Flexing for an innkeeper is a harmless, if slightly undignified, show of strength.
